rules: Every TV gets its own unique ID and record. Never reuse one TV's ID for another.
Nothing for an off-site TV may be tied to a home network address.
Nothing runs on a TV without its owner present, saying go.
home_networks_note: Your own home network(s) in CIDR form (192.0.2.0/24 is a documentation example). An OFFSITE TV may not use an address inside them; replace with yours.
lan_hostnames_note: Names of your own machines. An OFFSITE record, the off-site profile and anything tvkit writes for an off-site TV may not name one; tvkit refuses them like a private IP (lan_leaks). Replace with yours.
requests_url_note: Optional kit-wide default for the page open-requests / offsite-sheet / usb-pack point a TV at. Empty on purpose: set requests_url in a TV's record or pass --requests-url.

artifacts_location.note: APKs and any signing keystore are NEVER in git. Put the APKs in the artifacts folder (default ~/.local/share/tvkit/artifacts, or --artifacts / TVKIT_ARTIFACTS). tvkit check refuses any file whose sha256 or signer differs from the pins below.

free-my-tv.pin_note: PLACEHOLDER. Free My TV is built by you, from the pinned upstream commit, with your own signing key (build/build-free-my-tv.sh), so no hash can be shipped. Paste the sha256 and signer_cert_sha256 the build script prints, then run tvkit check.

settings.tmdb_key: (empty: no key baked in; each TV may add one in Home Settings -> TMDB key)
settings.latitude_longitude: 51.5074,-0.1278 (build default; each TV sets its own city on the TV: Home Settings -> City)

build.toolchain: JDK 17 + Android build-tools 34.0.0 + platform android-34, user space, no root needed

free-my-tv.city_on_tv: In the reviewed source (fa471834) the Home Settings row 'City' stores the city the owner types and uses it ahead of the build's default, so one build serves every TV.

tv-bro.signer_note: Upstream release key. Download the APK yourself from the upstream releases page; this kit only pins its version and hashes and ships no APK. usb-pack copies only the file you downloaded, after it matches the pin.

source.review_notes: Declares REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES (in-app updater; never grant unknown-apps), QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES and runtime camera/mic/location (never grant).

expect.note: With screensaver=keep the screensaver setting must be unchanged; with screensaver=app it must be io.freemytv/... .
